card.name: Spots where 'through' or 'via' comes next
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'through' or 'via' that names a route or means. Typical cases are 'directly or', 'known only', 'made accessible' and 'excreted'.

modes.label: Direct-or-indirect phrasing
modes.description: The word 'or' or a parenthesis after 'directly', before 'indirectly' and a route.

modes.label: Passive verbs before a route
modes.description: A passive verb or adjective after which a means or route phrase usually follows.
modes.example: It is not primarily excret<<ed>> via the urinary route

modes.label: Subject or object before a means phrase
modes.description: A pronoun, reflexive or noun after which 'through' introduces the means.
modes.example: who are known to us<< only>> through the traditionary legends

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is 'through' or 'via', and lowers unrelated rare words.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'through' or 'via' to name a route or means.
